cohort: Women with preterm premature rupture of membranes delivering between 23 and 33 weeks of gestation
finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with a higher risk of respiratory distress syndrome (RDS) in infants born after preterm premature rupture of membranes.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery, in the context of preterm premature rupture of membranes, was specifically identified as a risk factor for neonatal RDS.
